notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Stonecloaker between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
description:
Cast Stonecloaker by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the first Stonecloaker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Stonecloaker trigger, exiling a card from a graveyard.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
